target_customer: Consumers and knowledge workers who want to delegate tasks to AI agents and cut screen time; paid by hardware pre-order deposit plus a monthly membership
problem: Phones are built around apps that demand attention. Raven rebuilds the phone so users send agents to do jobs across Slack, Gmail and Notion and get reports back.
business_model: Hardware device with a planned monthly membership (reported as 99 to 199 USD per month) and a refundable 199 USD pre-order deposit

founders.name: Isa Usmanov
previous_startups: droov, restaurant ordering platform (reported 3.4M+ GMV, outcome not stated)
Co-founded an ed-tech SaaS (reported 1.2M+ ARR, outcome not stated)
An AI executive assistant startup (outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: Sole founder per the YC page. Says he has built software and hardware for 12 years. Won first place at OpenAI Voice Hack Night with an agentic phone OS project, which he credits for getting into YC.

competitors.name: Rabbit R1
competitors.what: Handheld AI device pitched as an app-driving agent; a second generation was being teased for 2026
competitors.traction_then: Still sold and updated in 2026, but reviewers say it never delivered the demoed agent behavior

competitors.name: Humane AI Pin
competitors.traction_then: Cloud service shut down 2025-02-28 per a 2026 review site

competitors.name: OpenAI agent-first smartphone (reported)
competitors.what: Rumored phone replacing the app grid with agent tasks; timelines conflict between reports and it was not released

technical_complexity.rationale: Combines a custom device or OS layer with reliable multi-app agent execution. A solo founder must handle hardware sourcing, software and agent reliability, which prior AI gadgets failed at.

defensibility.rationale: No stated proprietary technology or distribution. Platform owners such as Apple, Google and OpenAI can ship agent features on their own phones.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: As of late 2026 no incumbent had shipped an agent-first phone, but OpenAI was reported to be working on one. Too early to judge.

market_need_then: Consumer concern about screen time and the rise of agent tools such as Codex and Claude created demand for agent delegation. Early signal: reported inbound interest of over 1,000 people after the pre-order launch on 2026-11-04, from the founder's own X thread as relayed by one outlet.

branding.domain_note: Uses ravenphone.com rather than a bare raven.com; YC slug is ravenphone. Many other companies use the name Raven.

identity.logo: Raven wordmark with an animated orb graphic on the site
identity.voice_and_tone: Short, confident and a little playful, for example the line that a phone should not be exciting but a life should

branding.community_and_virality: Early press coverage of pre-orders on runtimewire; no merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear short name and a distinctive pitch line, but very early, many unrelated companies share the Raven name, and little brand press exists.

outcome_analysis: Raven is a Fall 2026 company that opened pre-orders on 2026-11-04, so there is no outcome yet. The main risks visible from the record are hardware execution by a solo founder, no disclosed funding, and incumbents with platform control. Prior AI gadgets such as Humane were shut down, so the category carries timing risk.
notes: No funding found for this company. Search results for funding mixed in unrelated Raven companies, which were ignored. Runtimewire did not name the founder in the body, but the YC page does. Legal entity is Sintem, Inc. per the company site.
